title: When gratitude feels distant after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: The heart notices absence faster than gift. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru keeps gratitude close to remembrance, contentment, and restored vision. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: Hardship is not automatically holy, but it can become the place where reality is finally faced. Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement.
actionPrompt: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
